paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates layer-group–wise relative change (in percent) for several token/precision configurations, shown across five grouped x-axis categories. The x-axis is categorical with labels “Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32,” arranged left to right at uniform spacing. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change,” uses a linear percent scale, and spans from about −25% at the bottom to about +5% at the top; visible tick labels include 5%, 0%, −5%, −15%, and −25%, and a gray dashed horizontal reference line (“Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit”) lies at 0% across all layer groups. Four solid lines with markers are plotted: (1) a yellow line with circular markers (“LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”) sits near 0% at Layer1-4 and Layer5-12, dips slightly below 0% at Layer13-20, returns to near 0% at Layer21-28, and ends slightly above 0% at Layer29-32; (2) a red line with square markers (“LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”) starts at 0% at Layer1-4, moves to a small negative value at Layer5-12, reaches its lowest point around Layer13-20 (below the −5% tick but above −15%), then rises to a small negative value at Layer21-28 and approaches 0% again by Layer29-32; (3) a light-blue line with circular markers (“RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”) starts slightly below 0% at Layer1-4, remains slightly negative at Layer5-12, drops to its lowest point at Layer13-20 (between −15% and −5%), then rises back toward 0% at Layer21-28 and ends slightly below 0% at Layer29-32; and (4) a dark-blue line with square markers (“RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”) begins below 0% at Layer1-4, decreases further by Layer5-12, reaches its minimum at Layer13-20 where the marker sits on the −25% tick, then increases to a value still below −5% at Layer21-28 and finishes higher (closer to 0%) by Layer29-32 while remaining negative.
